reviews.name: Faeyz Hamad
reviews.text:
مسجد جميل والناس عليهم نور ما شاء الله تبارك الرحمن
انصح بترك شيء من المال لمساعدة المسجد وارجو الاهتمام بنضافة الحمامات
reviews.textTranslated: A beautiful mosque, and the people there are radiant, may God bless them. I advise leaving some money to help the mosque, and I hope attention will be paid to the cleanliness of the restrooms.

reviews.name: Fadi Alhammadi
reviews.text:
المسجد مهمل بشكل كبير جداً
يرجى من اللجنة المسؤلة الأهتمام بهذا الأمر
reviews.textTranslated:
The mosque is in a very state of neglect.
We urge the responsible committee to address this issue.

reviews.name: H S
reviews.text: fraglich ob man hier nach den neuesten Nachrichten über die Süleymancilar Geld spenden sollte. Ich bin mir nicht mehr sicher ob Spenden auch wirklich dort ankommen wo sie sollten. Man sollte die Lage beobachten und dementsprechend handeln.
reviews.textTranslated: It's questionable whether one should donate money here after the latest news about the Süleymancilar. I'm no longer sure if donations actually reach their intended recipients. One should monitor the situation and act accordingly.

reviews.name: Murat Çiçek
reviews.text: Schöne kleine Moschee, wir sind unterwegs für Freitagsgebiet vorbeikommen
reviews.textTranslated: Beautiful little mosque, we're on our way to the Friday area, we'll stop by.

reviews.name: ramazan kılıç
reviews.text: MAŞALLAH ALLAH yapandan yaptırandan emeği geçenlerden razı Olsun Muhteşem bir eser ELHAMDÜLİLLAH 🌹
reviews.textTranslated: Mashallah, may Allah be pleased with those who made it, those who commissioned it, and those who contributed to it. A magnificent work, Alhamdulillah 🌹

reviews.name: Yasar Gündogan
reviews.text:
Çok nezih ve temiz bir Camii
Türkiye dönüşünde uğrayarak namazımızı eda ettik
Emeği geçen Müslüman kardeşlerden Allah razı olsun
reviews.textTranslated:
A very decent and clean mosque.
We visited and performed our prayers on our return from Türkiye.
May Allah reward the Muslim brothers who contributed to this.

reviews.name: cecile karaca
reviews.text:
Selamun Aleykum, dün gece Türkiye’den Fransa’ya dönerken namaz kılmak nasip oldu.
Caminiz çok güzel ve tertemiz idi.
Allah tüm emeği geçenlerden razı olsun.
reviews.textTranslated: Peace be upon you. Last night, while returning from Turkey to France, I had the opportunity to pray in your mosque. Your mosque was very beautiful and spotlessly clean. May Allah reward all those who contributed to it.
